# Original synthetic learning graph development package

This fictional source/returned-work package is for M1–M5 development only. It is not personal coursework, a held-out evaluation case, a learner outcome or an independently reviewed instructional diagnosis. Reference calculations are authored analytical checks; independent approval remains pending.

`scenario.json` separates source versions, observation, candidate interpretations and numerical oracle. `returned-work.svg` is an original marked-up source asset. Its transcription is authored, not model-extracted. Before live vision use, rasterize the asset through the controlled image pipeline; an SVG URL must not be treated as a supported provider image format by assumption.

When constructing model inputs disclose only authorized source/observation material and the supported model capabilities. Do not pass `reviewCandidates`, expected outcomes, case identifiers, reference answers or a branch label as instructions selecting the model's decision. A later learner response is genuine tool input for adaptation, not a scenario flag.

Acceptance variations: initial ambiguity; uninformative first experiment; contrary response; ambiguous/no-change response; student correction; explanation/help/reveal before response; source revision while queued; restart/retry/isolation; different fresh application; unreadable image/unsupported topic. Fold into existing development and held-out denominators. Keep held-out cases outside this tuning package. Typed observation and actual vision extraction are separate test modes.

Gap inventory: current source/attempt/investigation/prediction/jobs/audit modules are reused. Course-scoped linked records (M2), approved prediction forms (M3), complete exposure/correction and material follow-up contracts (M4), and local accessible inspection (M5) require implementation and evidence. Actual Spark, real Firestore and image-region acceptance cannot be inferred from scripted transport tests. See docs/LEARNING_GRAPH_MILESTONES.md for the exit contracts.
